reasons: Aggregation differs: Datadog sum:nginx.net.waiting sums across series, but the candidate uses avg(), which gives a per-series mean instead of a total.

Series set differs: the $Host template variable (prefix host, default *) should become a host matcher such as host_name=~"$Host" (the label must be checked against the dataset), but the candidate drops it.
Quantity and unit match: nginx.connections_current with state="waiting" measures the same waiting connections as nginx.net.waiting, and state is an observed dataset label.
Outcome translated is correct because an OTel metric measures the same quantity, so blocking is not required.
